The structure of Sr2Co2Pd2O10 (reduced formula SrCoPdO5) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 16 atoms in the unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis identifies octahedral Co and Pd centers, each coordinated by six O neighbors, while Sr adopts a close-packed-like 12-neighbor environment. Corner-sharing between CoO6 and PdO6 octahedra is observed, alongside face-sharing between CoO6 and Sr-centered 12-vertex polyhedra. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 16 sites.
